scope: One supervised V25f boot_a-only trial after V25d failed to expose SSH. V25f brings up proven V19 Wi-Fi/SSH first, saves diagnostics, then starts the same reviewed health stage. An independent 180-second power-off timer bounds the period before health startup. General Linux flash hold remains active.
abort_conditions: Unexpected Fastboot identity or write response, warm phone, USB still attached during native boot, missing early SSH by the bounded startup window, unexpected reboot/recovery, or missing health telemetry. Stop and inspect before any stock restoration.
